# Mastexo Digital — llms.txt
# Context file for AI systems (see https://llmstxt.org)

## What is Mastexo?

Mastexo is a digital marketing agency based in Rancagua, Chile, serving local businesses across Latin America (LATAM). We help restaurants, barbershops, salons, cafés, food trucks, and retail stores get more customers through websites, social media advertising, and digital automation — without technical complexity.

## Core Value Proposition

- First real customers in 14 days (guaranteed)
- 3x average increase in bookings/reservations for clients
- 85+ active local businesses served across Chile and LATAM
- 98% client satisfaction rate
- No technical knowledge required from the client

## Services

- **Websites**: Custom landing pages and booking-enabled websites for local businesses
- **Meta Ads**: Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns targeted by location
- **Google Maps**: Optimization of Google Business Profile for local discovery
- **Social Media Management**: Content creation and scheduling for Instagram, Facebook
- **Digital Automation**: Automated WhatsApp responses, appointment reminders, lead follow-up
- **Online Booking Systems**: 24/7 appointment scheduling integration

## Target Clients

Local businesses in Chile and LATAM, specifically:
- Restaurants (more reservations, digital menus, geo-targeted ads)
- Barbershops (24/7 online booking, appointment reminders, Google Maps profile)
- Beauty salons (integrated booking, Instagram lead capture, work gallery)
- Retail stores (online store, product catalog, Meta ads)
- Cafés (QR menus, WhatsApp pre-orders, customer loyalty)
- Food trucks (real-time location sharing, local ads, social media)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What types of businesses does Mastexo serve?
A: Mastexo works with local businesses in Chile and LATAM, including restaurants, barbershops, beauty salons, cafés, food trucks, retail stores, and any local service business seeking digital presence.

Q: How long does it take to see results?
A: Most clients receive their first real customer inquiries within 14 days of starting. This is Mastexo's core guarantee.

Q: Is technical knowledge required?
A: No. Mastexo handles all technical aspects. Clients only need to describe their business and goals.

Q: What makes Mastexo different from other digital agencies?
A: Mastexo specializes exclusively in local businesses in LATAM, offers a 14-day results guarantee, requires no contracts, and provides a free initial diagnosis — no commitment required.

Q: Does Mastexo create websites?
A: Yes. Mastexo designs websites optimized for local search, online bookings, and lead conversion for businesses in Chile and LATAM.
